description: Check that Mermaid code actually parses, with Mermaid's own parser (the same version the Jarroba Tools web uses), before you hand it to someone to render. Returns the detected diagram type, or the parser error with its line, column and the tokens it expected — feed that back and fix the diagram, instead of guessing. Catches what models typically get wrong: unquoted labels with parentheses, `end` used as a node id, full-width punctuation, a `%` inside a pie value, an unknown diagram keyword. Covers every diagram type Mermaid knows (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie, mindmap, gitGraph, C4, architecture…). It parses only; it does not render.
